evidenceMode: Read-only competitor UI and local source review

items.title: Branch hierarchy and business identity
items.acceptance: One organization owns multiple branches; every sale, receipt, order, payment and stock event records its branch; migrate current data to a default branch.

items.title: Stores, shelves and bins
items.acceptance: Each branch contains stores and locations; the same drug batch can have separate balances at multiple locations without duplicating the drug catalog.

items.title: Store rules and quarantine locations
items.acceptance: Define sellable, receiving, transit, returns and damaged locations; POS cannot allocate quarantined or non-sellable stock.

items.title: Branch and store access scope
items.acceptance: Assign permitted branches and stores to staff; enforce scope in server reads, writes, exports and background jobs; cross-branch access is explicitly authorized.

items.title: Batch-preserving internal transfers
items.acceptance: Dispatch from a source, track in transit, receive at destination; retain batch, expiry and cost; partial receipts and discrepancies remain visible.

items.title: Transfer approvals and reversal
items.acceptance: A distinct authorized receiver confirms delivery; duplicate dispatch/receipt cannot move stock twice; reversals use linked movements instead of editing history.

items.title: Branch dashboards and consolidated reporting
items.acceptance: Owners see consolidated and branch-filtered sales, margins, debt, stock and collections; transfers do not inflate organization-wide stock or revenue.

items.title: Purchase, dispensing and stock unit conversion
items.acceptance: Buy a pack of 100, sell 6 tablets, and retain 94 base units; product-specific conversion factors drive receipt, sale, return and transfer math.

items.title: Decimal quantities and unit precision
items.acceptance: Precision rules permit fractional quantities only for supported units; rounding never creates unexplained stock differences.

items.title: Stocktake sessions and variance approval
items.acceptance: Start a count by branch/store, capture observed quantities, review variance and reasons, approve once, and retain counter/approver and before/after balances.

items.title: Printable and importable count sheets
items.acceptance: Export a count sheet, optionally hide expected counts, import results with row validation, and post only reviewed variances.

items.title: Physical, reserved and available stock
items.acceptance: Reserve stock for queued checkout and transfers with an expiry; available equals physical less reservations; release reservations on cancellation or timeout.

items.title: Concurrency-safe stock allocation
items.acceptance: Two simultaneous buyers of the last unit produce one successful allocation; use atomic availability checks or locking and idempotent finalization.

items.title: Stock movement explorer and audit viewer
items.acceptance: Filter movements by branch/store/batch/reason/operator/document and drill through to origin; retain adjustment history and export it with permission checks.

items.title: Batch recall, quarantine and disposal
items.acceptance: Quarantine specific batches, trace affected sales, document disposal and block allocations; preserve existing FEFO and expired-stock exclusion.

items.title: Per-location reorder levels and suggested POs
items.acceptance: Calculate demand and lead-time-based reorder suggestions per drug/location using usable stock; approved suggestions create draft POs.

items.title: Product tax classes and effective rates
items.acceptance: A mixed basket distinguishes standard, zero-rated, exempt and out-of-scope classes with effective dates and line-level snapshots; validate local tax mappings before release.

items.title: Wholesale, promotional and minimum price tiers
items.acceptance: Retain cash and insurance prices; add wholesale and promotional tiers plus a margin/price floor with authorized override and audit.

items.title: Product images and receipt aliases
items.acceptance: Attach a product image and short label/receipt alias without losing generic name, strength or dosage form.

items.title: Hierarchical categories
items.acceptance: Allow parent-child categories and descriptions; search and reporting include child categories without double-counting sales.

items.title: Structured brands and manufacturers
items.acceptance: Maintain reusable brand/manufacturer records and references with contacts and origin; migrate free-text values without losing data.

items.title: Inventory items and service behavior
items.acceptance: Support pharmacy sundries and defined services; services do not consume drug stock, while tracked medicines retain required batch/expiry controls.

items.title: Validated CSV catalog import
items.acceptance: Preview mappings and errors, detect duplicates, choose create/update behavior, and import valid rows atomically or with a clear per-row result.

items.title: Supplier financial terms and opening balances
items.acceptance: Record contact person, tax identifier where needed, terms, credit limits and opening balance with audit; calculate overdue balances consistently.

items.title: Purchase-order drafting and approval
items.acceptance: Create supplier/branch/store POs with quantities, units, costs, tax, discounts, freight and expected delivery; move draft to approved with permission checks.

items.title: Partial receiving against purchase orders
items.acceptance: Receive less than ordered, retain outstanding quantities, and prevent over-receipt unless explicitly authorized; show draft, approved, partial, received and cancelled states.

items.title: Goods received notes and batch capture
items.acceptance: Capture actual quantities, lots, expiry and storage locations on a GRN; commit once to stock after review and link it to the PO.

items.title: Direct supplier invoice receipt
items.acceptance: Receive multiple drugs/batches directly from an invoice without a PO; one commit updates stock and supplier liability with a shared reference.

items.title: PO–GRN–invoice matching
items.competitor: Document links observed; matching controls proposed
items.acceptance: Flag quantity, price and tax discrepancies across ordered, received and billed items; do not pay a disputed document without an explicit override.

items.title: Supplier returns and credit allocation
items.acceptance: Return accepted quantities against original receipt batches, remove appropriate stock, record reason and credit, and allocate the credit against supplier bills.

items.title: Supplier statements and aging
items.acceptance: Opening debt plus invoices minus credits/payments equals closing debt; show due/overdue buckets and printable supplier statements.

items.title: Register opening, cash float and day close
items.acceptance: Open a cashier/register session with float; close with counted cash, expected cash, payments by channel, variance and supervisor approval.

items.title: Customer credit invoices and payment terms
items.acceptance: Permit an authorized credit sale with due date and customer limit; support partial settlement, outstanding amount and overdue status separately from insurance claims.

items.title: Customer debt settlement and statements
items.acceptance: Allocate payments to invoices, prevent duplicate receipts and show opening balance, invoices, credits, settlements and closing balance.

items.title: Quotations and conversion
items.acceptance: Prepare a quote with validity, quantities and terms; track pending/sent/accepted/rejected; convert once with a fresh stock and price check.

items.title: Partial sales returns and refund approvals
items.acceptance: Return only unreturned sold quantities, approve a refund, link payment reversal/credit and batch disposition, and never automatically restock unsafe returned medicines.

items.title: Sale voids and controlled corrections
items.acceptance: Void with reason and permission before dispatch where appropriate; corrections after completion use linked reversal/credit documents and preserve financial history.

items.title: Cashier UI for split tender
items.acceptance: A cashier splits one invoice across supported channels; pending versus confirmed payments and any insurance portion remain explicit; balance reconciles to total.

items.title: Additional payment channels
items.acceptance: Record card, bank transfer and Airtel Money with traceable references and reconciliation states; treat recorded tender separately from a certified gateway integration.

items.title: Quick-sale shortcuts and counter efficiency
items.acceptance: Preserve keyboard search/Enter selection; add clear checkout shortcuts, focus return and rapid repeat scanning; measure completion time using representative tasks.

items.title: Delivery charges and invoice remarks
items.acceptance: Record delivery/handling as explicit sale lines and notes, with correct totals and tax mapping; print a delivery document where needed.

items.title: Loyalty points ledger and redemption
items.acceptance: Earn/redeem through a traceable ledger, configure point value and expiry, reverse points on returns, and never confuse discounts with point balances.

items.title: Corporate accounts and account status
items.acceptance: Represent individual versus corporate payer accounts, account status, terms and optional billing identifiers while keeping patient clinical identity distinct.

items.title: SMS/email gateway and delivery history
items.acceptance: Configure tenant-scoped credentials safely; preview recipient selection and templates, queue delivery, record success/failure and enforce consent/preferences.

items.title: Overdue balance reminders
items.acceptance: Filter due and overdue invoices, preview SMS/email reminders, log sending and suppress settled accounts or opted-out recipients.

items.title: Prescription refill reminders
items.acceptance: Use refillDueAt to queue consent-aware reminders with quiet hours, deduplication, delivery status and patient-facing pharmacy contact information.

items.title: Immutable transaction-time cost snapshots
items.competitor: Unit cost shown; historical immutability unverified
items.acceptance: Snapshot cost on each batch allocation; changing a batch cost later must not rewrite previously earned gross margin.

items.title: Revenue, tax and COGS correctness
items.acceptance: Gross profit equals net sales excluding tax minus historical COGS after discounts and returns; collection of old debt does not count as new sales revenue.

items.title: Double-entry ledger and chart of accounts
items.acceptance: Post balanced, linked journal entries for sales, receipts, returns, stock and expenses; retain reversal history and make journal totals traceable.

items.title: Trial balance, balance sheet and income statement
items.acceptance: Generate statements from the same ledger and period rules; debit equals credit and assets equal liabilities plus equity; expose unresolved opening-balance differences.

items.title: Cash, bank and M-Pesa reconciliation
items.acceptance: Match each settlement to a payment exactly once; retain unmatched items, fees and variance; branch/register collection totals tie to the payment ledger.

items.title: Configurable expenses and other income
items.acceptance: Add user-defined categories, payment source, branch, attachments and approval; keep sales-derived income separate from manually entered other income.

items.title: Financial exports and report catalogue
items.acceptance: Offer permission-scoped CSV/Excel and print outputs for sales, payments, aging, stock, returns and branch summaries with consistent filters and totals.

items.title: Granular configurable permissions
items.acceptance: Separate cashier, pharmacist, branch manager, purchaser, accountant and owner privileges; require specific grants for price overrides, refunds, stock changes and exports.

items.title: Approval queues and actionable exceptions
items.competitor: Returns/GRN approval UI; unified queue proposed
items.acceptance: Show pending transfers, GRNs, returns, large discounts and reconciliation variances with ownership, age, review evidence and decision audit.

items.title: Staff directory and payroll profiles
items.acceptance: Maintain employee records linked to user and branch, salary details and employment state; payroll access is separately restricted.

items.title: Payroll allowances, deductions and advances
items.acceptance: Version allowance/deduction rules by period, track advance balances and repayment; validate applicable Kenyan payroll rules before production use.

items.title: Payroll runs, payslips and payment ledger
items.acceptance: Approve one payroll per period, produce payslips and exports, record partial disbursements and outstanding amounts, and prevent duplicate runs/payments.

items.title: Internal support tickets
items.acceptance: Create ticket with assignee, priority, attachment and threaded history; show pending items and permissions without sending messages automatically.

items.title: Correct M-Pesa callback and confirmation lifecycle
items.competitor: Configuration UI only; gateway not validated
items.acceptance: A failed callback remains failed; success extracts and verifies amount/receipt and updates the linked Payment atomically; duplicate callbacks are harmless.

items.title: Tenant/branch-specific gateway configuration
items.acceptance: Scope business numbers and secure credential references to the owning tenant/branch; use the chosen environment in actual requests; never expose secrets in UI responses.

items.title: eTIMS submission and credit-note lifecycle
items.acceptance: Implement queued submission, acknowledgment, retries, reconciliation and credit-note linkage; validate official current KRA integration requirements before specifying production acceptance.

items.title: True offline selling and safe synchronization
items.acceptance: Persist supported transactions locally, show pending sync, deduplicate on reconnect and resolve stock conflicts; define supported tenders and protect data on logout/device loss.

items.title: Safe retries and document numbering
items.acceptance: Use idempotency keys and concurrency-safe document sequences per scope; retrying checkout, GRN or transfer cannot duplicate stock, payment or numbering effects.

items.title: Structured pharmacist review and clinical safety
items.competitor: Prescription manager claimed; comparable workflow not observed
items.acceptance: Retain doctor-to-pharmacist-to-cashier handoff; capture structured allergies and review decisions; use validated clinical evidence and overrides rather than treating AI text as clearance.

items.title: Expiry loss prevention and branch redistribution
items.acceptance: Rank batches at risk by expiry, quantity, demand and value; suggest branch transfers or supplier returns with review before execution.

items.title: Fast onboarding, migration and release proof
items.competitor: Catalog import observed; wider migration proposed
items.acceptance: Import opening batches, balances, suppliers and patients with a reconciliation report; validate critical workflows with two-branch acceptance scenarios and recovery drills.

schemaBlueprint.status: Proposed design; no operational schema changes
schemaBlueprint.provenance: Inferred from inspected UI workflows and existing local Prisma models; competitor database not accessed
